name: u27-v2 prospective replication on real DANDI data — 3-Dandiset replication

hypothesis: UTFE U_star synchrony order-parameter R (rolling 200) and LCC v3 R-3 above-C indicator (Pearson rolling N=20 > C*=0.4370) are POSITIVELY correlated on real neural data across all available channel-pairs.
statistic: Pearson(U_star_score, LCC_above_C_indicator) computed across channel-pairs per Dandiset.

utfe_params.metric: Kuramoto-style synchrony order parameter R from analytic-signal phase

pass_27_stake: If u27-v2 returns REJECT on real DANDI data (Pass-29 u27 synthetic also REJECTed at r=+0.0547), the Pass-27 §3 8-bridge claim 'PhiFE <-> LCC v3' is REFUTED across both synthetic and real data and must be permanently retired from the integration table.
per_dandiset_verdict: Each Dandiset returns one verdict in {CONFIRM, REJECT, PARTIAL}. Aggregate verdict: 3/3 CONFIRM = SURVIVES; >=2/3 REJECT = REFUTED; mixed = MIXED-EVIDENCE pending sensitivity analysis.

amendments.honesty_note: This amendment was added AFTER the first runner pass observed that DANDI:000114 contains only 1D RoiResponseSeries data. Per architect code review, the eligibility criterion was not predeclared in executable logic and the original runner emitted a CONFIRM verdict from a degenerate lagged-trace fallback. The amendment formalizes the exclusion as an executable rule (runner.py emits 'INELIGIBLE') and is applied uniformly to all 3 Dandisets in the rerun.
amendments.rule: A Dandiset is ELIGIBLE for u27-v2 verdict only if its NWB session contains a genuine 2D channel x time data array. 1D-only sessions are marked INELIGIBLE and excluded from aggregate scoring (since lagged copies measure autocorrelation, not cross-channel coupling).
amendments.impact_on_000003_000053: neither — both contain genuine 2D arrays; verdicts unchanged on rerun.
amendments.impact_on_000114: verdict changes from CONFIRM (from lagged-fallback) to INELIGIBLE.

honesty_caveats: DANDI:000003 description in Pass 31 §5.2 wrongly stated 'Allen calcium imaging'; actual: Buzsaki lab hippocampal ephys (YutaMouse). #69 honesty correction logged in Pass 32.
DANDI:000053 ephys files are 40+ GB; we use remfile streaming to read only the subsetted portion (<100 MB transfer per file).
Subset (10k samples / 6 channels) is a first-pass; if results are borderline, full-session re-run is required before final verdict.
